$comment: Single source of truth for managed coding-agent plugins. Top-level marketplaces/plugins are Claude Code declarations; codex.marketplaces/plugins are Codex CLI declarations. install/common/agents.sh registers marketplaces and installs plugins idempotently; scripts/dotfiles/update.sh 'plugins' updates them. Claude marketplace names must match the source repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json because settings.json enabledPlugins keys on <plugin>@<name>.
